subject: ddl: args v2 for create/drop/modify schema (#55919)
summary: Refactors DDL job args v2 for create/drop/modify schema (and related truncate/drop consumers) to use typed args structs via `Job.FillArgs`/`Job.FillFinishedArgs`, with v2 args encoded in `Job.RawArgs` and decoded through `model.Get*Args` helpers; updates DDL execution, delete-range insertion, and GC placement-rule cleanup to read the new finished-args forms.
